verdict.rationale: Highnote docs confirm KYC/KYB compliance is handled in-house through the platform (highnote-docs-23), account holders must have an approved application before card issuance (highnote-docs-4), and identity verification documents are collected when an application enters manual review (highnote-docs-16). However, there is no documentation of specific data requirements per verification type, a full taxonomy of review states, or explicit re-verification/periodic refresh flows. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB data field requirements, enumerated review-state lifecycle, and evidence of re-verification/refresh triggers post-onboarding.
